features: Adds a new split Registration Desk interface with dedicated Leader and Follower registration panels
Removes the operator-facing Role dropdown from the new Registration Desk workflow
Leader and Follower panels each provide independent BDC search, optional bib, Add Existing and Create Name & Add actions
Desktop shows Leader and Follower registration side by side; mobile stacks Leader then Follower
Reuses the existing registration backend for eligibility, official BDC ID creation, duplicate and bib validation, check-in, ready status, removal and live synchronization
Routes the Registration Desk directory root to the new split-role interface while retaining index.php as the existing JSON/API backend
Keeps bib assignment optional and editable after registration
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
